description: This file defines the ConnectionManager class responsible for managing network connections within the Orleans distributed framework. It handles connection creation, reuse, termination, and shutdown procedures, utilizing asynchronous programming patterns, thread safety mechanisms, and logging.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages network connections, including establishing, reusing, terminating, and shutting down connections within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: ConnectionManager.ConnectionEntry
classes.description: Represents a set of connections to a specific endpoint, tracks pending connection attempts, last failure time, and active connections.

classes.name: ConnectionLogScope
classes.description: Provides logging scope for connection-related logs.

methods.name: ConnectionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ConnectionManager with configuration options, connection factory, and trace logger.

methods.name: ConnectionCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of active connections.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Task that completes when the connection manager is shut down.

methods.name: GetConnectedAddresses
methods.description: Returns a list of currently connected endpoint addresses.

methods.name: GetConnection
methods.description: Retrieves an existing connection to the specified endpoint, or initiates a new one if necessary.

methods.name: TryGetConnection
methods.description: Attempts to get an existing connection to the specified endpoint without initiating a new connection.

methods.name: GetConnectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously establishes or retrieves a connection to the specified endpoint, with retry logic.

methods.name: OnConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles logic when a connection attempt fails, updating last failure time and resetting pending connection.

methods.name: OnConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a connection is successfully established.

methods.name: OnConnectionTerminated
methods.description: Handles cleanup and logging when a connection is terminated.

methods.name: GetOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ConnectionEntry for a given endpoint.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to connect to an endpoint, with timeout and error handling.

methods.name: CloseAsync
methods.description: Closes all connections to a specific endpoint.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Shuts down all connections managed by the ConnectionManager.

methods.name: StartConnection
methods.description: Starts running a connection in the background, handling its lifecycle.

methods.name: RunConnectionAsync
methods.description: Runs the connection, handling errors and termination cleanup.

methods.name: BeginConnectionScope
methods.description: Creates a logging scope for a connection if enabled.
